blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – Zamboanga City Mayor Khymer Olaso has offered a P100,000 cash reward from his personal salary for credible and verifiable information leading to the identification and arrest of the perpetrators behind the fatal shooting of his former executive assistant. Olaso announced the bounty on Wednesday, Nov. 18, following the death of Vivencio “Jon” Villasan Cruz, 51, who succumbed to gunshot wounds on Tuesday night. Cruz was ambushed along the bypass road in Barangay Lunzuran on Monday night. The mayor said the reward is meant to encourage witnesses or anyone with relevant knowledge of the attack to […]...
